tier1.text: Blood leaves the liver through the right, left and middle hepatic veins. The liver has already processed the nutrients and toxins in this blood. Each hepatic vein empties into the inferior vena cava, a large vein that returns blood to the heart.

quotes.quote: This processed blood, as well as the systemic blood that came from the hepatic artery, exits the liver via the right, left, and middle hepatic veins, and flows into the inferior vena cava.

quotes.quote: After processing the bloodborne nutrients and toxins, the liver releases nutrients needed by other cells back into the blood, which drains into the central vein and then through the hepatic vein to the inferior vena cava.
